1.title: Trump threatens to bomb bridges and power plants unless Iran resumes talks
1.summary: Trump's comments aired as the two countries exchanged fire for the fourth day in a row and the US resumed blockading Iranian ports.

2.title: Jay Clayton Expected to Face Tough Questions in Confirmation Hearing
2.summary: His nomination to lead the U.S. intelligence community comes as the White House pushes to use declassified intelligence to show concerns about election security.

3.title: Senator Mark Kelly Amasses Nearly $25 Million Campaign War Chest
3.summary: The Arizona Democrat said he had raised and given away $10 million to fellow members of his party and committees as he mulls a presidential run in 2028.

4.title: Kenyan court dismisses Rastafarians' bid to legalise cannabis
4.summary: The court acknowledged the need for a broader national debate on cannabis policy in Kenya.

5.title: Sierra Leone drops treason charge against ex-president over attempted coup
5.summary: Ernest Bai Koroma was arrested in 2023 after gunmen broke into an armoury and some jails, freeing inmates.

6.title: China economic growth falls sharply, missing target
6.summary: Weak demand domestically and the impact of the Iran war on oil prices overshadowed the country's strong exports.
